name: Local 3D interstellar dust (Edenhofer et al. 2024)
description: Retrieval nodes for the local 3D dust map of Edenhofer et al. (2024, A&A 685, A82): the posterior mean of the published NSIDE-256 HEALPix-times-distance map (Zenodo 10658339, CC BY 4.0), read by HTTP range (1.63 GB of the 3.25 GB file; the STD data is never read), resampled in WASM to a heliocentric Galactic grid of 20 pc voxels (125 x 125 x 61, |z| <= 610 pc, r <= 1248 pc) with volume-weighted means, and emitted as 61 SDS $PCE rows, one per z plane, for analysis/milky-way-model load_dust_map.

sequentialJustification.detail: Each stage deposits the HEALPix samples of its shell ranges into one voxel accumulator and plans the next ranges; the flow serializes stages and the provider node runs one cycle at a time, so the guest never spawns a thread.
